scope: Manual CPU input/cell/character budget analysis; no inference, tokenizer, executor, query solutions or new tests.
prompt_function: build_direct_prompt; lengths computed by the current function, without chat-template rendering or tokenization
interpretation: This public set has at most three queries per task. The broad input/demo-shape proxy peaks at 3600 cell tokens; all 120 remain below 8192 under this explicit rough convention.

Even three legal 30x30 outputs have 2700 cells, or 5400 tokens at 2/cell before JSON syntax. Multi-query count alone therefore does not show a natural 8192-token final-output bottleneck on these 120 tasks.
The proxy is not a query-output size bound: the inferred rule may resize beyond observed demo/input shapes. The 30x30 scenario is a format-limit scenario, not an accuracy claim.

Actual tokenization, formatting, reasoning-to-final transition, malformed/verbose output and remaining context can change available/used final tokens. Character counts are not token counts; no exact tokenizer sufficiency claim is made.

The requested generation total includes thinking; GEN-THINK=8192 describes nominal final space when thinking uses its cap, not a guaranteed separate token reserve. The current per-request context clipping preserves this gap where possible, but a nearly full prompt can leave less space.

known_P0_cost_and_240_task_limit.data_scope: Previous fixed DeepDirect6: 6 tasks/9 queries, one P0 each, MTP2, L4x4; selected public development subset, not representative hidden data.
limitations: These are arithmetic scenarios, not hidden-runtime predictions or new measured throughput.
Generation is one shared task-level call for all queries, so do not multiply the per-task cap by public query count.
Hidden task count, query multiplicity, prompt lengths and early stopping are not established by the public 120/172 inputs.
Observed six-task workload and concurrency do not prove the rate for a full eight-request queue; MTP acceptance and prefill can vary.
No source, threshold, route, generation budget or prediction policy was changed by this analysis.
